faq_heading: Homes near James Kennedy Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the James Kennedy Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the James Kennedy Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active houses, townhomes and condos whose listing description names James Kennedy Elementary. MLS® listings are not tagged by school, so a nearby home whose listing does not name the school will not show, and a listing that does can be farther than 1 km away.

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Langley school finder. A home a few blocks from James Kennedy Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near James Kennedy Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.
Walk the route to James Kennedy Elementary the way a child would, and count the crossings and sidewalks.
